This is not scientific proof, but an exploration of where two worldviews intersect.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
MIRi Privacy Policy

Last updated: March 16, 2026

1. Information Collected
- Name, date of birth, gender (for fortune/compatibility analysis)
- Face photos (for face reading analysis)

2. Purpose of Use
- Providing AI-powered fortune, face reading, and compatibility analysis services

3. Third-Party Services
- OpenAI: AI analysis processing
- Supabase: Data storage

4. Data Retention
- Face photos: Automatically deleted within 30 days after analysis
- All data: Immediately deleted upon account deletion

5. User Rights
- You may request to view, modify, or delete your personal information
- You may delete all data by deleting your account
- Contact: miri.fortune.app@gmail.com

This service is provided for entertainment purposes only and does not replace professional advice for important decisions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.body:
MIRi Terms of Service

Last updated: March 16, 2026

Article 1 (Service Purpose)
MIRi is an entertainment service providing fortune telling, face reading, compatibility, and horoscope analysis.

Article 2 (Payment Policy)
1. Detailed analysis is available at $0.99 per analysis.
2. Refund policy follows Apple App Store and Google Play Store policies.

Article 3 (Disclaimer)
1. This service is provided for entertainment purposes only.
2. It does NOT constitute medical, legal, or financial advice.
3. The service is not responsible for users' judgments and actions based on analysis results.

Article 4 (Account Deletion)
1. You can delete your account in Settings > My Page > Delete Account.
2. All data is deleted immediately upon account deletion.

Article 5 (Contact)
Service inquiries: miri.fortune.app@gmail.com
